comment: The public roadmap. `bun nv site --check roadmap` keeps it in step with the goal chain, and `bun nv site --roadmap` copies it into README.md. `internal` lists the goals that are not public work.

themes.title: Refactoring from the command line
themes.text: `nvs code rename` renames a class or a method everywhere it is used. `nvs code move` moves a file and updates every `require` that loads it. `nvs code find` finds a class or a method by its name. `nvs code calls` lists the callers of a method, and `nvs code reach` lists the routes and tests that use it.
